responsibility: Implements GCC’s optimization statistics collection and dumping support. It maintains per-pass hash tables of named counters and histogram buckets keyed by pass static number, records event increments from passes, emits incremental per-pass statistics into active dump files when TDF_STATS is enabled, writes detailed or summary global statistics dumps through a registered .statistics dump, and coordinates initialization/finalization with the pass manager and dump manager.
same_name_distinction: Implements the statistics subsystem behind the declarations in statistics.h: it owns the per-pass counter/hash-table storage, registers and opens the .statistics dump, updates counters for events and histograms, and emits per-pass or summary output.
